data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, 250−8k remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 25 at 18 leave 50, then 500 or 100: recovery isn't guaranteed, nor is long-run optimality. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Fisher05/Fisher17, please help recruit individual opt-ins.
